pattern_rationale: LabTrak LIS is an isolated SQLite relational database without an HTTP API, message feed, or change-data-capture stream. Read-only SQL polling on a scheduled interval is the most direct and least intrusive mechanism to extract patient demographics and laboratory result records.

alternatives_considered.why_not: LabTrak LIS lacks an HTTP API service to wrap.
The system does not emit HL7 v2 or real-time event messages.
The system stores data in a persistent SQLite database file rather than generating scheduled export files.

sync.detail: Poll SQLite database file on a configured cron schedule (e.g., every 15 minutes) querying records updated since the last poll checkpoint.

field_map.transform: Map to identifier object with system 'http://hospital.example.org/mrn' and value from MRN_NO
Convert YYYYMMDD integer/string to ISO date YYYY-MM-DD format
Map to code.coding[0] with system 'http://loinc.org', code LOINC_CD, and display TEST_REF.TEST_NM
Construct logical reference subject.identifier = {'system': 'http://hospital.example.org/mrn', 'value': PT_MSTR.MRN_NO} via join LAB_RSLT.PT_ID = PT_MSTR.PT_ID
Parse string 'YYYYMMDDHHMMSS' and format as UTC ISO dateTime 'YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ'
Parse string to decimal number; if non-numeric or qualitative, omit valueQuantity and set valueString
String copy via join LAB_RSLT.TEST_CD = TEST_REF.TEST_CD

risks: Non-numeric values in LAB_RSLT.RSLT_VAL (e.g. qualitative text or comparison signs like '<0.01') will fail numeric parsing into Observation.valueQuantity.value.
SQLite database lock contention if the pipeline polls while local LabTrak applications are performing batch writes.
Unparsed timestamps without timezone offsets are assumed UTC, which may lead to offset discrepancies if source values were captured in local hospital time.
human_review_points: Confirm local timezone policy for COLL_DTTM and RSLT_DTTM timestamps before enforcing UTC assumption.
Verify whether non-numeric RSLT_VAL values should map to Observation.valueString or trigger qualitative Observation concepts.
Confirm that local test code TEST_CD fallback mapping is required when LOINC_CD is null in TEST_REF.
